title: High-Power Household Desktop SittingCrawling Floor Fan
body_html:
Product information:
Overview:
This industrial-grade floor fan features a powerful motor design, delivering stable and strong airflow suitable for various settings including homes, offices, workshops, and construction sites. Its low-noise operation ensures a quiet and comfortable environment while providing a cooling breeze.

Specification:
Material: Plastic, Metal
Parameters:
Rated Voltage: 220 V
Rated Power: 120 W
Rated Speed: 1,400 rpm
Noise Level: Less than 36 dB
Energy Efficiency Grade: Level 3
Control Type: Mechanical Control
Wind Speed Settings: 3 Levels
Airflow Mode: Oscillating Blades
Timer Function: None
Size:
Available sizes include 10-inch (250mm), 12-inch (300mm), 14-inch (350mm), 16-inch (400mm), 18-inch (450mm), and 20-inch (500mm), catering to different space requirements.


Packing list:
1 x Floor Fan
